backfillRows.value:
Chinostes was a saddle-maker of Pol-Reanphoros who never sought divinity: it found him when he took up his tack knife against a raiding warlord and won. As a hero-god he kept protecting Reanpharos until a vampire bested him and dragged him into undeath. He remains a folk hero at heart, hunting the other terrors of the night from the rooftops — and now and then feeding on an unwary citizen. His cult has split: the Nightwardens worship him as a pragmatically violent folk hero who does what must be done; the Redeemers mourn what he became and hope to restore him.

**Areas of Concern** tragedy and sacrifice

**Edicts** aid your neighbors, sacrifice others for the greater good, leave cryptic calling cards of your actions

**Anathema** disparage others for seeking terrible power to achieve laudable goals

**Religious Symbol** heart pierced by two swords

**Sacred Animal** horse

**Sacred Colors** black, white

**Divine Font** harm

**Divine Skill** Acrobatics

**Favored Weapon** dagger

**Domains** cities, death, luck, sorrow

**Sanctification** can choose unholy

**Cleric Spells** 1st: jump, 2nd: gecko grip, 7th: true target
